_comment: This file is the TABLE OF CONTENTS for all attack types we track.
_comment2: Think of it like a library catalog — it tells you WHAT attacks exist and HOW they're classified.

categories.name: Identity & Account Attacks
categories.description: Attacks where the attacker compromises accounts or fabricates identities (Account Takeover, Synthetic Identity, Credential Abuse)

attack_types.name: Account Takeover
attack_types.description: Attacker takes full control of a legitimate user's account

attack_types.name: Synthetic Identity
attack_types.description: Stitching real SSN fragments with AI-generated identities for credit line exploitation

categories.name: Social Engineering
categories.description: Manipulating individuals into voluntary payments via AI-driven impersonation and phishing

attack_types.name: AI Impersonation & Deepfake Social Engineering
attack_types.description: Cloned executive/vendor voice and AI phishing emails forcing unauthorized wire approvals

categories.name: Payment Manipulation
categories.description: Tampering with payment payloads, QR codes, and transaction authorizations

attack_types.name: Payment Redirection & QR Manipulation
attack_types.description: Redirecting payment destinations via altered QR codes and API payload tampering

categories.name: Transaction Behaviour
categories.description: Anomalous velocity abuse, rapid fund movement, and multi-account coordination

attack_types.name: Velocity & Pattern Abuse
attack_types.description: Rapid multi-account bursts and automated card-testing scripts

categories.name: Merchant & Refund Fraud
categories.description: Exploiting merchant refund policies, dispute abuse, and transaction laundering

attack_types.name: Refund & Merchant Manipulation
attack_types.description: Coercing chatbot agents into issuing unauthorized refund credits and dispute payouts

categories.name: Money Movement & Mule Networks
categories.description: Multi-hop fund laundering through smurfing, dormant mule accounts, and rapid cash-out bursts

attack_types.name: Money Movement
attack_types.description: Multi-hop fund routing through mule rings and rapid layering cash-outs

categories.name: GenAI-Native & Emerging
categories.description: Autonomous GenAI agents, real-time voice/video deepfakes, synthetic identity generation, and adversarial evasion

attack_types.name: GenAI-Native Attacks
attack_types.description: AI-orchestrated social engineering, synthetic biometrics, and adaptive evasion against fraud detectors

severity_levels._comment: These define how serious each severity level is

critical.description: Immediate financial loss and account compromise

signal_catalog._comment: Master list of ALL detection signals used across all attacks. Each signal is a 'red flag' the system watches for.

signals.name: new_device
signals.description: Transaction originates from a device not previously associated with this account

signals.name: new_location
signals.description: Transaction originates from a geographic location not seen before for this account

signals.name: new_beneficiary
signals.description: Payment is being sent to a recipient the account holder has never paid before

signals.name: amount_deviation
signals.description: Transaction amount is significantly different from the account's normal spending pattern

signals.name: velocity_deviation
signals.description: Number of transactions in a time window is higher than the account's normal rate

signals.name: time_deviation
signals.description: Transaction happens at an unusual time compared to the account holder's normal activity hours

signals.name: fan_out_degree
signals.description: Ratio/count of outbound transfers split from a single funding source within a short time window

signals.name: fan_in_degree
signals.description: Ratio/count of incoming transfers converging into a single master accumulator account

signals.name: transit_velocity_sec
signals.description: Transit latency between incoming funds and outbound forwarding (near-zero transit indicates mule behavior)

signals.name: amount_layering_ratio
signals.description: Percentage of received funds immediately forwarded to downstream nodes (zero retention)

signals.name: shared_device_cluster
signals.description: Origin, intermediary mules, or destination accounts sharing common device fingerprint or IP subnet

signals.name: account_dormancy_score
signals.description: Dormant/aged account suddenly exhibiting high-velocity high-volume fund movement

signals.name: llm_semantic_intent_score
signals.description: NLP semantic urgency and prompt injection coercion score detected in interaction transcripts

signals.name: voice_biometric_jitter
signals.description: Acoustic micro-tremor and sub-band jitter absence indicating AI voice cloning

signals.name: synthetic_face_embedding_dist
signals.description: Sub-surface optical skin scattering and facial feature vector duplicate distance

signals.name: adversarial_perturbation_index
signals.description: Statistical entropy shift indicating black-box gradient perturbation to evade risk thresholds

mitigation_catalog._comment: Master list of ALL possible responses when fraud is suspected. Ordered from least to most aggressive.

mitigations.name: step_up_authentication
mitigations.description: Ask the user to verify their identity (e.g., OTP, biometric, security question)

mitigations.name: review
mitigations.description: Flag the transaction for manual review by a fraud analyst

mitigations.name: hold
mitigations.description: Temporarily hold the transaction and notify the account holder

mitigations.name: block
mitigations.description: Immediately block the transaction and freeze the account
